description.en:
Clic activities based on the text book "Conocimiento del Medio de 4º de E. Primaria, de la editorial Santillana". The topics treated are:
  • Primitive men
  • The Romans
  • The age of castles
  • The age of discoveries
  • Your great grandparents age
    You'll find more information in the pages "Aplicaciones educativas".
